e was a green folder in the top drawer of the nightstand. She kept her medical directive there. She said if anything happened in the night she did not want the paramedics to have to go looking."

Asha crossed the room. The nightstand was small, dark wood, with a brass pull. The drawer slid open with the small reluctance of old runners. Inside: a rosary, a tube of hand cream, a paperback novel in Spanish with a bookmark a third of the way through, a flashlight, two AA batteries loose and rolling, and no folder of any color.

She straightened and stood looking at the drawer for a long moment.

"Rosa," she said, "when did you last see the medical directive in this drawer."

"Three days before she died."

"You're sure."

"I read it to her. She asked me to. She wanted to make sure it said what she remembered it saying."

"And it did."

"It did."

"Did she say anything that day about the will."

Rosa's face did something small and complicated. She glanced, not at Daniel, but at the doorway behind which Daniel was standing — at the air where his attention was — and then she said, "She said, *Rosa, when the time comes, make sure the green folder in the desk goes to the lawyer first. Before anyone else opens the desk.* I told her I would."

"And did you?"

"On the morning after she died I went to the desk and the drawer was already open. The folder was not there. I thought perhaps Lucia had taken it. I went down to the kitchen and Lucia was at the table with her coffee and she had not

EVENT-ROLE:

  experiences : Character -experiences-> Event               (internal mental/emotional event)

SOCIAL:
  kinship_with  : Character -kinship_with-> Character        (kinship or marital)
  affinity_with : Character -affinity_with-> Character       (friends, allies, collaborators)
  hostility_with: Character -hostility_with-> Character      (enemies, rivals)
  affiliated_with: Character|Concept -affiliated_with-> Concept  (belongs to org/faction)

INTER-EVENT:
  precedes      : Event -precedes-> Event      (earlier in time/narrative order)
  causes        : Event -causes-> Event        (directly causes or triggers)
  contrasts_with: Event -contrasts_with-> Event (contrast or parallel in outcome)
  references    : Event -references-> Event    (refers to, recalls, describes another event)

SPATIOTEMPORAL:
  occurs_at  : Event -occurs_at-> Location|Vehicle      (event occurs at a location or aboard a vehicle)
  occurs_on  : Event -occurs_on-> TimePoint              (event occurs at a time point)
  located_at : Character|Object|Concept|Vehicle -located_at-> Location|Vehicle
  present_on : Character|Object|Concept|Vehicle -present_on-> TimePoint

OBJECT-RELATED:
  possesses : Character|Concept -possesses-> Object|Vehicle   (owns or holds)
  uses      : Character|Object -uses-> Object|Vehicle         (operates another object or vehicle)

SEMANTIC:
  is_a    : Character|Object|Concept|Vehicle -is_a-> Concept     (type-instance or subclass)
  part_of : Object|Location|Character|Concept|Vehicle -part_of-> Object|Location|Concept|Vehicle  (part-whole)
